'''Mike Dalton EPP Mains/Beatdown (Intermediate)''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Mike Dalton]]
* '''Published:''' July 1999 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|SE-L-mindwhatyouhavelearned.gif|label=Mind What You Have Learned}}
* '''Strategy:''' EPP Mains/Beatdown (Intermediate)
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PEndor EPP MainsBeatdown (Intermediate).txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

I got this deck design from Mike Dalton, a player who's tearing it up in northern New Jersey. The object of Mike's deck is to create more battle damage by using EPP mains with weapons, Yoda at his hut, and Draw Their Fire and Frozen Assets. '' Ray Bordier, Coruscant region''

== Strategy ==

Gameplay You start with your Objective and the Dagobah System. Play Goo Nee Tay or Draw Their Fire as your starting effect using The Signal. You'll want to establish a Force draining presence on Cloud City. If your opponent is playing a ground-based deck, use Frozen Assets to prevent force use, and battle your opponent at their weakest location by deploying your main characters and using Nabrun Leids to move them from location to location.

It is a fairly simple deck to use, the hardest part may be getting the exact cards. The mains are quite essential., but you can substitute for most of the other characters.
